lineage.marginUnits: Per family, in that family's own semantic units: consistency share for persistence, segment slope for reversal. A single global number would compare unlike quantities.

properties.property: No admitted case touches the range bound.
Every case labelled PERSISTENT validates as PERSISTENT under V1.
The last observed value has not yet crossed the threshold.
The produced series contains opposite, non-trivial early and late slopes.
The produced series repeats exactly at its declared period.
Realized high-volatility RMS exceeds the high floor and low stays under the low ceiling.
Net displacement and slope both stay inside the flat ceiling.
The window is genuinely below the minimum sample count.

floatingPoint.policy: Ordinary semantic families target bucket interiors. Exact-edge behaviour is tested by explicit boundary probes, never by a certification family, and the frozen head is not altered to suit a generator that aimed at an unstable edge.

effectiveVariationBefore.note: Effective variation counts distinct produced series and distinct parameter tuples, whichever is smaller. Stage 2L.19 found effective n = 3 behind 300 inherited cases; this is the guard against repeating that.

effectiveVariationAfter.note: Effective variation counts distinct produced series and distinct parameter tuples, whichever is smaller. Stage 2L.19 found effective n = 3 behind 300 inherited cases; this is the guard against repeating that.

interpretation.boundaryFragilityNote: 6 family/families are well posed on the certification corpus but fail somewhere in their declared parameter range: direction/RAMP_UP, direction/RAMP_DOWN, cycle/MONOTONE, timeToThreshold/APPROACHING, timeToThreshold/APPROACHING_4_TO_8, abstention/SHORT_HISTORY. The corpus never visits those points, so nothing certified rests on them, and the ranges are recorded rather than silently narrowed.

portabilityNote: Stage 2L.10 through 2L.22 remain DIGEST_PRODUCED_SINGLE_PLATFORM. Stage 2L.23 does not change that.
